context: A boss briefs his manager on next quarter's expansion plan
purpose: Teach: 通称/共済/修了/貯蓄/休業/出店/創出/なさる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来期の拡大計画について話そう。社内通称『北極星プロジェクト』だ。
lines.en: Let's discuss next quarter's expansion plan. Internal codename: 'Polaris Project.'
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening a formal strategic briefing

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。具体的には何店舗の出店計画になりますか？
lines.en: Understood. Concretely, how many new stores does the opening plan cover?
lines.style: Diligent middle manager asking a practical follow-up question

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 全国で十二店舗だ。地域での雇用創出も同時に進めてほしい。
lines.en: Twelve locations nationwide. I want job creation in those regions pursued in parallel.
lines.style: Authoritative boss laying out concrete numerical targets clearly

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解です。研修を修了したスタッフを中心に配置すれば回せそうです。
lines.en: Got it. Staffing mainly with people who've completed training should make it work.
lines.style: Confident manager proposing an operational solution with measured tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それと別件だが、社員の貯蓄を支える共済の仕組みも見直したい。
lines.en: On a separate note, I also want to revise the mutual-aid scheme supporting employee savings.
lines.style: Authoritative boss bridging smoothly into a related HR topic

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 良いご判断だと思います。長期の休業中の補償も対象に入りますか？
lines.en: I think that's a good call. Does long-term leave compensation fall in scope too?
lines.style: Respectful manager voicing genuine appreciation and clarifying scope

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろん含める。来週の役員会では君に説明してもらうつもりだ。
lines.en: Of course it's included. At next week's board meeting, I'm having you present it.
lines.style: Authoritative boss delegating the presentation task to subordinate

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 私がですか…身の引き締まる思いです。資料の準備にすぐ取りかかります。
lines.en: Me, sir? It really tightens my resolve. I'll start on the materials right away.
lines.style: Humble manager pivoting from surprise into a concrete next step

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだぞ。質問は何かなさる前提で、想定問答も用意しておいてくれ。
lines.en: Counting on you. Assume they'll ask questions, so prep anticipated Q&A as well.
lines.style: Authoritative boss giving final instructions with respectful verb form
